title: NIST WebBook: Silver is Ag, molecular weight 107.8682 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Silver as Ag, molecular weight 107.8682 amu, CAS 7440-22-4.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Silver, CAS Registry Number 7440-22-4, lists molecular formula Ag and molecular weight 107.8682 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 106.905097 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Ag. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
